judgments.reason: Data shows gas share at 79.7% in 2025, which makes it clearly the dominant electricity source.
Renewables grew significantly to 16.9%, but fossil fuels (mostly gas) still account for 83.1% of the mix in 2025.
The heavy reliance on gas (79.7%) creates a structural concentration risk grounded in the electricity mix data.
